bundle.shortDescription: A friendly desktop that talks to OpenCode
bundle.longDescription: OpenCode OS boots into a Windows-style desktop environment whose apps are wired directly to the OpenCode CLI: a file viewer, notepad and a floating chat box to your local AI agent.
